schema.description: One session of exercise a Garmin watch recorded, shaped as an IEEE 1752 physical-activity-1.0 payload with the FIT session's other figures beside it in snake_case. The anam_garmin importer sends each session in the activity FIT files GarminDB downloads, one per sport of a multisport activity. Values are the watch's own, apart from the activity name, which the importer maps. A Garmin Cardio session often spans the machine sessions done during it, which the Technogym and Concept2 leaves also hold, so a sum across the leaves counts that time twice. This is the Garmin leaf of activity.exercise-session: Garmin's own payload shape, named for its vendor, so a reader asks about exercise across the leaves by the prefix activity.exercise-session. and knows which shape each fact has. Version 1 is activity.exercise-session v2 cut to the fields Garmin writes, each with the same rules, and its facets came across in the vendor-leaf rename (renames/vendor-leaves.json), each the next version of itself with its payload unchanged. The shared core, id, activity_name, effective_time_frame and source, is the same on all four leaves of activity.exercise-session (internal/def/shared-core.json).

activity_name.description: The IEEE 1752 activity name, mapped by the importer from the FIT sport and sub-sport: walking to walking, running on a treadmill to running.treadmill, indoor rowing to rowing.machine, cardio training to other (Google Fit has no general cardio), and any pair it has no mapping for to unknown. fit_sport and fit_sub_sport keep what the watch wrote.

avg_hr_bpm.description: Average heart rate in beats per minute: the session's avg_heart_rate.

avg_power_w.description: Average power in watts: the session's avg_power.

base_movement_quantity.description: The stroke count, as an IEEE 1752 movement count: the session's total_strokes, on sessions that count strokes.

value.description: The source's stroke count, as reported.

distance.description: Distance covered in metres: the session's total_distance, left out when the watch reports zero, as it does for a session that measures no distance.

cumulative_elevation_gain.description: Total ascent in metres, as an IEEE 1752 elevation gain: Garmin's session total_ascent. Only on sessions that record altitude.

descent_m.description: Garmin's session total_descent, total descent in metres. Only on sessions that record altitude.

duration.description: The session's net duration in seconds: its total_timer_time, which leaves out time the timer was paused, so it can be shorter than the interval.

effective_time_frame.description: When the session happened, as an IEEE 1752 time interval.

duration.description: The session's length in seconds: its total_elapsed_time, start to stop with pauses included.

value.description: Seconds, a whole or decimal number.

start_date_time.description: The start, ISO 8601 with offset, to the second: the FIT session's start_time, a true UTC instant written with Z. This is the fact time.

fit_sport.description: The FIT session's sport, as the Garmin FIT SDK names it, or its number when the SDK has no name for it ("54" is the watch's Safety profile).

fit_sub_sport.description: The FIT session's sub-sport, as the Garmin FIT SDK names it, or its number when the SDK has no name for it.

id.description: garmin:session: and the session's UTC start, as the importer writes it.

kcal_burned.description: Energy burned in kcal: the session's total_calories.

max_hr_bpm.description: Peak heart rate in beats per minute: the session's max_heart_rate.

max_power_w.description: Peak power in watts: the session's max_power.

source.description: Which app the session came from: always "Garmin", written by the importer.

source_time.description: How the session's start was read: value is the FIT start_time, UTC by the format's definition (basis source). Not required, as in activity.exercise-session v2.

value.description: The fact time as the source supplied it, as text and never rewritten: a date, a wall clock, an RFC 3339 string, or an epoch as its digits.

zone.description: The zone value is read in, and nothing else: an IANA name when one is known, UTC for a value that is UTC, else a fixed offset +HH:MM or -HH:MM. The gate refuses a name that is no zone.

basis.description: Who decided the zone. source: the source supplied it with the value, or the value is UTC by the source's own definition. configuration: a setting a person made for this source names it. assumption: the importer or writer chose it, with nothing behind it but its own default or the Definition's zone, and logged that it did.

sport_profile.description: The name of the activity profile on the watch that recorded the session, Garmin's sport_profile_name, such as Cardio, Walk or Safety.

training_effect_aerobic.description: Garmin's session total_training_effect, its aerobic training effect on a 0 to 5 scale, computed by the watch.

training_effect_anaerobic.description: Garmin's session total_anaerobic_training_effect, its anaerobic training effect on a 0 to 5 scale, computed by the watch.

training_load.description: Garmin's session training_load_peak, the training load the watch computes for the session; Garmin does not publish how.
